name: Eddy
author: E. T. Carter
description: A slow galactic swirl — colour poles smeared into spiral arms by a differential rotation that winds tighter toward a luminous off-centre core, inter-arm dust darkening between them. A drifting colour-field with a sense of rotation rather than a still gradient.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the whole swirl; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Wind
params.effect: How tightly the arms wind with radius; low is open and lazy, high coils them in.

params.label: Core glow
params.effect: Brightness of the luminous galactic core; 0 leaves an even swirl.

params.label: Blob size
params.effect: Influence radius of the colour poles before they smear into arms.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
